title: TwelveSpec active V1 gap closure plan

modules.title: Governance, identity and settings
modules.observed: Scoped memberships, seller records, audit and immutable records exist.
modules.missing: Finish action/resource policy, grants, membership lifecycle, seller assignment, evidence-based activation and recovery.

modules.title: Executive dashboard
modules.observed: Tasks, exceptions, owner time and dashboard summaries exist.
modules.missing: Calculate whole-dataset KPIs, connect real waiting/SLA events and expose remediation with reconciled owner-time metrics.

modules.title: CRM and sales pipeline
modules.observed: Contacts, accounts, lead transitions, activity and lead import exist.
modules.missing: Add transactional identity/merge, complete relationship/follow-up lifecycle and RFQ/order timeline.

modules.title: Canonical catalog and publishing
modules.observed: Published snapshots, bulk preview, revisions, collections and exact-image projection exist.
modules.missing: Unify canonical identity, complete media/variant editing and safe rollback; replace capped search.

modules.title: Integration Center
modules.observed: Provider registry, local encrypted credentials, CSV/XML staging and mock capability setup exist.
modules.missing: Managed vault, native independent service profiles, full wizard, scheduled evidence refresh and licensed ASI remain incomplete.

modules.title: Product rules and visual options
modules.observed: Typed AST, rule analysis, templates, zone records and batch assignments exist.
modules.missing: Bind authoritative family/options/zone revisions to UI, designer, quote and server validation.

modules.title: Creative Studio
modules.observed: Private raster preview, immutable versions, visual proof and synthetic render jobs exist.
modules.missing: Fix exact variant/spec binding; persist/scan assets; complete 2D editing and method-specific production review.

modules.title: Pricing and estimating
modules.observed: Decimal component estimates, tiers and margin checks exist.
modules.missing: Fix premature unit rounding and eligible source/policy selection; complete revisions, freight/tax assumptions and approvals.

modules.title: Customer storefront and checkout
modules.observed: Catalog, product options, customer sessions, carts, RFQs, accounts and reorder exist.
modules.missing: Preserve program/kit/artwork identity, server-side pagination/shareable filters and authorized complete commitment flows.

modules.title: Company, school and event stores
modules.observed: Program types, membership, standalone budget checks/reservations and fundraiser references exist.
modules.missing: Enforce the policy in cart/quote/order, make reservations idempotent across the lifecycle, finish redemption and program closeout.

modules.title: Build Your Own Bundle
modules.observed: Template/components, private source proposals and separate calculator costs exist.
modules.missing: Carry kit identity, packing/assembly/freight and component allocations through cart, agreement, jobs and fulfillment.

modules.title: RFQ, quote and approvals
modules.observed: Costed quotes, margin approvals, issued revisions, acceptance and immutable order lines exist.
modules.missing: Bind seller, credit, tax/freight, exact art/configuration; complete decline/expiry/revision and concurrency behavior.

modules.title: Orders and job tickets
modules.observed: Jobs, fixed operations, readiness guards, QC and exceptions exist.
modules.missing: Build component/decorator routes, enforce operation dependencies and quantities, and complete decorated production/rework flows.

modules.title: Purchasing and supplier POs
modules.observed: Mock PO approval, idempotent submission and UNKNOWN_OUTCOME reconciliation exist.
modules.missing: Purchase by requirement, verify approved payload hashes and implement separately authorized native submit/reconcile profiles.

modules.title: Production, QC, shipping, returns
modules.observed: Mock partial shipments, tracking projections and return/remake requests exist.
modules.missing: Finish provider events, allocation quantities, audited return/remake resolution and duplicate-label prevention.

modules.title: Finance and profitability
modules.observed: Immutable actual costs, mock payment/invoice references and profit snapshots exist.
modules.missing: Complete real reference adapter contracts, partial refunds/corrections, actual owner-time closeout and whole-dataset reporting.

modules.title: Marketing and content management
modules.observed: Drafts, consent-filtered local previews and operator attribution exist.
modules.missing: Complete content revisions, approval invalidation, segments, suppression and approved communication contracts.

modules.title: Automation and notifications
modules.observed: Typed AST, dry run, local safe effects, throttling and idempotent runs exist.
modules.missing: Unify real emitted names, durable leases, rule revisions/runtime dependency enforcement and operator recovery.

modules.title: Reporting and data quality
modules.observed: Saved report types, freshness views and CSV exports exist.
modules.missing: Use complete scoped aggregates, server paging, KPI definitions, quality remediation and unified safe exports.

modules.title: Reserved module slots
modules.observed: A Coming Soon directory and backend mutation denial exist.
modules.missing: Preserve all deferred placeholders and negative tests; do not activate AI, 3D, digitization, SaaS, GL/payroll or enterprise MRP.

workItems.title: Repair traceability and preserve the controlling scope
workItems.observed: The inventory has malformed command paths, a nonexistent future service/test, stale run labels and no E01-E25 mapping.
implementation: Correct source references without promoting acceptance
Map all 205 inventory entries and 95 scenarios
Separate source existence, observed test results and external verification
completionChecks: All 20 modules, 86 screens, 99 commands and 95 scenarios map to work and a verification target
Future commands remain required denials, not planned active implementations

workItems.title: Make the approved development database durable
workItems.observed: Previews currently use container PostgreSQL; the Supabase connection remains disabled after SELF_SIGNED_CERT_IN_CHAIN. Product IDs and sessions can disappear on reseed.
implementation: Install the approved CA with hostname verification and the restricted runtime role
Run migrations through a separate migration identity
Separate startup readiness from migrations/seeding and persist stable records across image changes
completionChecks: Create a cart, design and CRM contact; restart the preview container and read the same IDs and hashes
Connection failures produce a bounded health error without disabling TLS

workItems.title: Persist and scan private artwork and derivatives
workItems.observed: Originals and raster previews are local files; no independent malware scanner is configured, and file writes can outlive failed database transactions.
implementation: Add an object-store interface with a dedicated private development bucket
Track upload, quarantine, scan, derivative and retention states
Garbage-collect orphan uploads and bind object hashes to scoped metadata
completionChecks: Artwork survives container replacement and is denied to other buyers/workspaces
Unscanned/failed-scan files cannot become production derivatives; restore verifies bytes and hashes

workItems.title: Replace the local credential vault with a scoped managed broker
workItems.observed: Supplier secrets use a local AES-GCM file store with its key on the same temporary filesystem.
implementation: Keep the local implementation for tests only
Implement server-only managed-vault resolution, replacement, revocation and rotation
Preserve structured provider fields and masked metadata without browser retrieval
completionChecks: No raw credentials in GET, logs, receipts, exports or client bundles
Replaced credentials cannot be used and cross-scope resolution is denied; restore/rotation are exercised

workItems.title: Align action, role and resource authorization
workItems.observed: Authorization is mostly module-level; resource grants are explicitly unenforced. A manager is allowed by the marketing approval handler but rejected by central module authorization.
implementation: Create a typed command/permission registry with deny-by-default resource rules
Apply the same policy to API, service and UI affordances, including aliases
Add scoped grant expiry/revocation and production session/recovery controls
completionChecks: A role-by-action/resource matrix covers every command and denied side effects
Manager campaign approval behaves consistently with policy; customer and cross-venture escalation attempts fail

workItems.title: Constrain authoritative domain relationships and revisions
workItems.observed: Scoped foreign keys and immutable triggers exist, but many business relationships, quantities and money values remain unconstrained JSON; update revision checks are optional.
implementation: Promote critical business keys, relationships, numeric values and state constraints to typed columns incrementally
Add uniqueness for source/variant, buyer budget, contact identity and provider references
Require optimistic revisions and canonical command digests where editing can conflict
completionChecks: Invalid cross-product or cross-aggregate links fail in the database
Concurrent edits and duplicate/reordered commands cannot silently replace agreements or create duplicate obligations

workItems.title: Unify emitted events and durable processing
workItems.observed: Emitters use request.submitted, quote.issued, quote.accepted, job.ready and shipment.dispatched, while several workflow subscriptions use different names. The worker has row locks but no durable lease contract or dedicated system identity.
implementation: Define a shared versioned event registry and payload schemas
Propagate request correlation and origin actor
Add bounded claims, lease recovery, backoff, dead letters and audited replay with a dedicated worker identity
completionChecks: An actual customer command emits an event that triggers its matching published rule exactly once
Kill a worker after claiming an event; recovery preserves safe effects and does not replay ambiguous external writes

workItems.title: Repair preview navigation and actionable failure states
workItems.observed: Commerce OS Open storefront points at localhost. Generic controls and status labels do not establish all contracted views or role affordances.
implementation: Resolve cross-app links from validated environment origins
Show permission-aware actions and human-readable remediation
Preserve form drafts and provide loading, stale, empty, conflict and retry states
completionChecks: Every cross-app link opens the correct HTTPS preview
A denied or expired session preserves user work and exposes the next safe action

workItems.title: Bind every design and proof to its exact product variant
workItems.observed: The designer does not rebind an existing project when color changes; proof lookup falls back to a non-unique document hash, and cart validation only checks that a design version exists.
implementation: Store an immutable product/variant/method/zone specification snapshot on each version
Restore the saved variant and start/rebind a variant-specific project safely
Resolve proofs by exact version and specification, and validate line ownership and compatibility
Preserve order-bound historical evidence; use explicit change-order holds and reapproval for intended order changes
completionChecks: Save Clay, switch to Midnight, save and reload: each proof and cart line retains its own color
Identical text on two products never loads or approves the other product proof
Draft editing cannot rewrite accepted artwork; an intended order change records a hold and accepted amendment

workItems.title: Correct precision, pricing policy and source eligibility
workItems.observed: tierCost rounds unit prices to two decimals before extension; a 0.0250 unit cost for 1,000 becomes 30.00 instead of 25.00. costLine excludes only DISABLED offers, so ROLLED_BACK offers are not excluded. Margin floors are hard-coded rather than bound to configured policy.
implementation: Retain four-place supplier unit precision through extension and round totals deliberately
Select explicit eligible source/variant/service evidence and reject rolled-back/stale sources
Apply versioned policy, component completeness and exact residual allocation
completionChecks: Tier, quantity and rounding boundary tests reproduce and close the 25-versus-30 defect
A newer rolled-back offer is never chosen; configured floors and unknown costs cannot be bypassed

workItems.title: Enforce store policies through the real cart and order lifecycle
workItems.observed: Store checks exist as standalone commands, but safeLines drops storeId and brandKitId. Cart/RFQ/quote acceptance do not enforce the program; budget reservations are not tied to spend/release/cancel transitions.
implementation: Preserve and validate program references on every line
Calculate budget commitments from authoritative reviewed prices, not a buyer-entered amount
Implement approval, reserve, capture, release, redemption and fundraiser-reference transitions with locks
Bind approval to the recorded policy/quote/amount revision and return existing receipts before reevaluating a duplicate reservation
completionChecks: Calling cart/RFQ APIs directly cannot bypass membership, assignment, deadline, brand, seller or budget
Two concurrent accepted quotes cannot overspend; retry and cancellation restore the correct reservation once

workItems.title: Carry kit identity and packing costs into the agreement
workItems.observed: The bundle calculator records packaging and assembly separately, but the storefront flattens a saved kit into ordinary product cart lines and loses the kit configuration and operations.
implementation: Persist a kit line plus immutable component/variant/quantity selections
Price packaging, assembly and multi-source freight in the quote
Decompose component requirements and a separate kitting operation from the same snapshot
completionChecks: A saved kit reaches quote/order/jobs with unchanged component ratios and packing/assembly costs
Missing required components, wrong variants and component MOQ/availability changes block commitment

workItems.title: Complete issued agreement, seller, credit and expiry logic
workItems.observed: Immutable revisions exist, but draft quote edits do not synchronize quote_lines, seller selection uses the first legal entity, and credit exposure is checked at issuance rather than reserved at concurrent acceptance. Decline/expiry/cancel and tax evidence need complete workflows.
implementation: Resolve seller and venture explicitly and keep draft/revision/line projections consistent
Bind pricing, configuration, artwork and tax/freight assumptions to the issued revision
Add decline/expiry/revision flows and atomic credit/prepay commitment checks
Allow eligible sandbox checkout only with verified exact route, artwork, stock, freight and tax evidence; default to Request Quote
completionChecks: Two simultaneous acceptances cannot exceed a credit limit
An expired or mismatched revision cannot be accepted; changing the seller later leaves old agreements intact; unknown tax does not become a false settled charge

workItems.title: Unify canonical identity and source ownership
workItems.observed: A catalog identity helper requires brand, while import matching uses a separate SQL path that can match an empty brand. GTIN checks are mostly format checks; source-to-product linking and field ownership are incomplete.
implementation: Use one verified identity resolver across imports and adapters
Separate supplier product and part IDs from canonical variant IDs
Add reviewed merge/split, curated-field ownership and provenance for every changed field
completionChecks: One manufacturer model across three suppliers becomes one product with three distinct private offers
Empty/ambiguous brand or mismatched color/size never auto-merges; split/merge retains source lineage

workItems.title: Finish streaming import mapping, review and reversible changes
workItems.observed: CSV parsing is bounded, but the whole upload is buffered; XML only accepts flat product rows. Import rollback tracks created records but not all before-images of updated records.
implementation: Add private multipart staging, encoding checks and bounded streaming parsing
Support approved nested/namespace-aware XML selectors with inferred mapping previews
Store full row diffs, field overrides, resumable chunks and conflict-aware rollback manifests
completionChecks: A 10,000-variant import stages, reviews and commits without auto-publication or leaked raw data
Reject entity/DTD/depth attacks; rollback restores changed values without overwriting later human edits

workItems.title: Create licensed media and publication projections
workItems.observed: Cap imagery is corrected, but other synthetic families use generic category drawings; imported external image URLs are not an approved local derivative pipeline.
implementation: Ingest permitted media to private originals and approved public derivatives
Bind exact color, view, source rights and expiry to each image
Compute publication eligibility independently of sync success and preserve the prior safe revision
completionChecks: A nontechnical administrator can map and publish a licensed exact-variant image
Unlicensed, wrong-color or stale media cannot silently become the public image; failed sync retains the last safe publication

workItems.title: Join configuration families, options and actual imprint zones
workItems.observed: Rules and zones can be saved, but zones are not bound to exact variant/method/view validation; configure can accept a supplied template rather than resolving the authoritative product assignment.
implementation: Persist typed option groups, values, method/variant compatibility and versioned zones
Resolve effective templates server-side and share deterministic guidance with the UI
Validate lead times, MOQ and dimensions against the same immutable configuration
completionChecks: Direct API calls cannot select a different template to bypass the assigned constraints
Invalid method/location/size combinations are visibly disabled and rejected; 100-product assignments have preview and safe revert

workItems.title: Implement audited method-specific production review
workItems.observed: preflightDesign always returns BLOCKED and release_production_asset always fails; decorated production cannot complete through supported user commands.

partialProgress.change: Preliminary preflight now reports PASS, FAIL and UNVERIFIED, preserves measured raster resolution and leaves producer DPI/bleed requirements null without an authoritative profile.
partialProgress.verification: 143 automated local tests and nine local browser journeys pass; four new domain cases and persisted forged-profile rejection are included.
partialProgress.remaining: Versioned provider profiles, exact product/configuration binding, qualified technical review and validated production output remain open. Production readiness stays BLOCKED; no deployment occurred.

implementation: Add versioned provider/method profiles and checks against actual files and zones
Add an authorized manual prepress review of a scanned, immutable production derivative with evidence and reason
Preserve separate visual approval and production release; automated digitization/3D/PDF-X automation remain deferred where specified
completionChecks: A synthetic reviewed print derivative completes the decorated order route through public application commands
Missing fonts/profile/bleed/stitch evidence or changed variant/file blocks production and supplier dispatch; no client boolean can forge a pass

workItems.title: Finish shared editor, brand-kit and batch rendering behavior
workItems.observed: Designer, account proof and worker renderer use different placement geometry; batch renders use a generic rounded rectangle rather than the product image. Brand-kit and layer editing are limited.
implementation: Share one versioned scene/placement model and renderer
Support the active 2D layer, brand-kit, version history and batch review operations
Add queue progress, partial failures, cancellation and exact product/variant derivatives
completionChecks: Designer, saved proof and batch output place the same artwork in the same product zone
500 queued jobs retain exact variant/version identity and expose failures without declaring production readiness

workItems.title: Implement the provider SDK and reviewed PromoStandards profiles
workItems.observed: Only one bundled Product Data v1 fixture adapter exists. Admin connection tests are simulated; media, inventory, pricing, PO, status, ASN and invoice native operations are not implemented and wired.

partialProgress.change: A bounded external test verified native PCNA staging Product Data 2.0.0 and Media Content 1.1.0 using issued staging credentials. Returned blank-photo and raster-template assets loaded from the supplier CDN. SinaLite public sandbox catalog/detail reads also succeeded without authentication.
partialProgress.verification: Native WSDL/XSD checks, actual staging response evidence, guarded request construction and artifact credential scan; account-specific results remain private.
partialProgress.remaining: The TypeScript SDK, Integration Center diagnostics and worker are not wired to these services. Durable secrets/assets, exact source mapping, additional capabilities and full acceptance remain open. No production API or order was used.

implementation: Implement the shared adapter SDK with typed errors, pagination, rate limits and independent operations
Register approved supplier WSDL/XSD profiles and exact service versions
Join product, part, location, FOB, charge and currency evidence without assuming universal schemas
completionChecks: Each supported operation passes its own positive/negative fixture contract and preserves redacted correlation evidence
An authorized read-only sandbox test is recorded before its capability can become SANDBOX_VERIFIED; writes require separate authorization

workItems.title: Complete the nontechnical integration setup wizard
workItems.observed: Provider cards, mapping, price policy and mock diagnostics exist, but supported API setup is incomplete without per-service profiles, structured credential forms and end-to-end sample checks.
implementation: Deliver all nine controlling wizard steps with provider-specific fields
Show per-operation readiness, mapping, effective prices, freshness and safe remediation
Configure known supported supplier accounts without source edits; unsupported proprietary protocols remain explicit adapter work
completionChecks: A fresh administrator configures a supported supplier, rotates a secret, maps variants, changes pricing, previews and publishes eligible products without source edits
Wrong auth, unsupported schema, rate limit or stale cost produces a specific next action and no false success

workItems.title: Honor independent synchronization and freshness policies
workItems.observed: The UI stores separate schedules, but the worker advances only a catalog interval and sync_now records a synthetic result without updating service-specific evidence.
implementation: Schedule product/media, price, inventory and status jobs independently
Add cursors, checkpoints, contract-aware throttles and freshness windows
Keep merge reviews and publication independent of upstream refresh
completionChecks: Advancing a test clock triggers only the due service and does not overrun rate limits
A failed inventory/price refresh marks only affected evidence stale while preserving approved public data

workItems.title: Complete licensed ASI SmartLink and separate ESP interfaces
workItems.observed: ASI currently exposes activation requirements and BLOCKED capabilities; no account-authorized SmartLink client exists.
implementation: Obtain entitled account documentation and explicit catalog/image terms
Build the authorized search/detail adapter and its mapping, rate and retention rules
Keep ESP Updates and Connect distinct, with only approved requested operations available
completionChecks: Without entitlement, the interface stays accurately blocked and never sends an ESP+ UI password
With authorized sandbox credentials and schema, independently verify supported search/detail operations and licensed projection

workItems.title: Finish multi-source MIS routing and operation execution
workItems.observed: Current allocation creates one job per order line and a fixed operation list. Operations, resources, production events and QC are not a complete component/decorator route.
implementation: Create versioned fulfillment demands, source routes, materials and decorator operations
Enforce readiness, dependency, time, quantity, waste and QC transitions
Add blocked/rework/cancellation recovery without rewriting the agreement
completionChecks: An embroidered cap, commercial print item and event kit create distinct source/decorator/kit operations and jobs
Skipping required operations or QC, using stale approval, or changing a locked route is rejected and remediable

workItems.title: Authorize and reconcile POs at purchase-requirement level
workItems.observed: One active PO per job prevents a blank supplier and decorator PO for the same job; approval authorizationHash is recorded but not verified on submission. External submission is mock only.
implementation: Source and purchase by requirement/operation, including blank and decorator suppliers
Bind approval to exact payload, source, cost, route and artwork
Persist provider write intent before sending; reconcile UNKNOWN_OUTCOME before any retry
completionChecks: One job can have independently approved blank and decorator POs without duplicate requirements
Mutating an approved payload invalidates authorization; timeout/crash/replay creates at most one simulated external purchase

workItems.title: Complete shipments, tracking, returns and remakes
workItems.observed: Partial shipment projection works, but returns/remakes only create requests and do not validate the full line/quantity lifecycle. Carrier labels and supplier events remain blocked/simulated.
implementation: Add line-level return/remake authorization, quantities, receipt/QC and resolution
Normalize monotonic provider tracking with late-event reconciliation
Separate supplier tracking, own labels, cancellations and financial/budget adjustments
completionChecks: Split shipments and returns conserve quantities across allocations
Another order line cannot be returned; duplicate/late events and label retries create no extra shipment, purchase or refund

workItems.title: Reconcile finance references and complete direct-profit closeout
workItems.observed: References are mock-only; partial refunds, adjustments and reconciliation exceptions are incomplete. Actual-cost fallback keys can collapse distinct identical costs; closeout accepts manually supplied owner hours.
implementation: Use explicit source document/line identities and correction entries
Reconcile authorized/settled/failed/refunded provider amounts and currencies without treating OS as a ledger
Close against complete actual-cost evidence and linked owner time, with unresolved discrepancies visible
completionChecks: Distinct equal-value costs remain distinct while a replayed source document remains single
Partial refund, credit, canceled PO and remake reconcile without double counting revenue, tax or direct cost; GL/payroll stay Coming Soon

workItems.title: Complete CRM identity, relationships and follow-through
workItems.observed: Contact duplicate detection scans only 1,000 rows and is not a unique transactional key; account relationships and follow-ups have limited lifecycle/UI linkage.
implementation: Constrain normalized identities and support reviewed merge without losing history/consent
Add account/contact roles, activity timeline and owned follow-up state transitions
Link lead, RFQ, quote and order records while keeping marketing permission separate
completionChecks: Concurrent duplicate creation cannot split the same scoped contact
Import/merge preserves provenance and opt-out; a follow-up opens its linked customer/quote and can be completed or rescheduled

workItems.title: Complete content revisions, audience rights and suppression
workItems.observed: Marketing publishes a local preview only. Content editing/reapproval, segment logic, unsubscribe/suppression and durable attribution are incomplete; regex content checking is not a future HTML sanitization pipeline.
implementation: Add immutable content revisions and approval invalidation on edits
Model consent/withdrawal, suppression and recipient eligibility at send time
Keep test sending blocked and implement a provider-neutral approved communication interface
Add approved content-revision publication to the private preview CMS with sanitized structured content
completionChecks: An edited approved campaign cannot publish its old approval; opted-out contacts are always excluded
Test accounts produce no outbound mail; draft, review, rejection, scheduled preview and attribution are usable

workItems.title: Calculate whole-dataset KPIs and honest exports
workItems.observed: Reports sum at most 1,000 fetched rows; Today also limits records without a whole-dataset aggregate. Saved report columns are not a complete scoped report builder.
implementation: Use indexed scoped SQL aggregates with explicit periods, currency and metric definitions
Build drill-down reports, waiting/SLA queues and data-quality remediation
Use one hardened paged/streamed export path and saved view schema
completionChecks: Adding the 1,001st matching record changes the correct total and drill-down count
CSV/export privacy and formula controls match the displayed scope; owner-time and profit metrics reconcile to authoritative records

workItems.title: Finish versioned automation, approval and replay UX
workItems.observed: Typed AST and local safe effects exist, but real event wiring is incomplete, definitions are stored in automation_runs, and dependencies/maxDepth are not a complete runtime execution contract.
implementation: Add immutable rule revisions, effective dates, fixtures and traceable execution context
Enforce cycles, depth, throttles, human approvals and bounded escalation
Add operator simulation, disable, inspect, retry and dead-letter recovery
completionChecks: Publishing requires the exact tested definition and replay does not duplicate an effect
A real missed-supplier-date or approved-proof event produces the intended safe task/exception and cannot authorize spend or external sends

workItems.title: Complete governance and legal seller assignments
workItems.observed: Role editing and legal entities exist, but invitations/revocation, venture assignments, effective grants and evidence-backed module activation are incomplete.
implementation: Add scoped membership lifecycle and explicit seller/venture/channel assignments
Keep owner recovery and last-owner protection
Validate module enablement against accepted capabilities and leave future actions denied
completionChecks: Changing a future seller assignment leaves issued agreements unchanged
Revoked membership cannot act; no module flag activates unimplemented transactions or bypasses acceptance gates

workItems.title: Replace capped snapshots with paginated query APIs
workItems.observed: Server list limits are 200/1,000 while both interfaces paginate/filter already-fetched data. The storefront cannot search a 100k-variant catalog reliably.
implementation: Add cursor-based scoped listing/search/facets with whitelisted sort/filter fields
Index canonical product, variant, source, date and status keys
Persist shareable customer filters and stable product routing; handle retired/changed product references explicitly
completionChecks: Search finds a product beyond the first 1,000 variants with stable next/previous cursors
Filters survive URL reload and no public search document leaks private source data

workItems.title: Close security, confidentiality and migration gates
workItems.observed: RLS/immutable-record tests exist, but all-resource role coverage, public-surface leak checks and SCA/SAST/secret scanning are not established by the 139-test baseline.
implementation: Add command/resource/column confidentiality tests across APIs, HTML, SEO, images, logs, CSV and generated documents
Harden webhook ingress, uploads and endpoint aliases
Add dependency, static, secret and migration checks with reviewed exceptions
completionChecks: Every critical command has unauthorized, cross-scope, stale revision, duplicate and rollback tests
No unwaived critical/high security finding; staging runs with the actual restricted identities and no production credentials

workItems.title: Make observability and recovery operational
workItems.observed: A local synthetic database restore passed, but combined hosted database/object/vault restore, actionable alerts, incident runbooks and durable diagnostics remain unverified.
implementation: Propagate correlation IDs and redacted typed failure causes
Monitor freshness, queue leases, ambiguous POs, failed scans and reconciliation
Exercise isolated database/object/secret restoration and a safe preview rollback
completionChecks: A fault can be traced from browser command to transaction, worker and provider fixture
Restore into a separate development target verifies IDs, hashes, scopes, object bytes and role access within documented recovery objectives

workItems.title: Implement supported POD, shipping and accounting adapters
workItems.observed: Provider registry entries currently expose simulators or activation blocks rather than complete selected-provider clients.
implementation: Implement versioned provider-neutral contracts and selected reviewed adapter profiles
Add OAuth/refresh, signatures, pagination, recovery and sandbox-specific routing as applicable
Keep quote-only/manual fallback for unsupported or disconnected services
Resolve callback tenant/connection from registered authority, never the demo tenant or untrusted payload; keep administrative Access protection separate
completionChecks: Mocks cover the exact supported operations and negative cases without external effects
Authorized sandbox tests verify each operation separately; disconnected services never show Paid, label purchased or order transmitted

workItems.title: Deliver recoverable GitHub source and actual CI evidence
workItems.observed: The selected GitHub repository is public and has only its initial main branch; no implementation workflow runs exist. The working build/greenfield-v1 branch is local.
implementation: Prepare a privacy-reviewed branch/PR with no credentials or private operational files
Resolve repository confidentiality before publishing the supplied handoff
Execute pinned CI checks and retain commit-specific artifacts outside the ephemeral preview
completionChecks: The implementation commit is reachable in the authorized repository and a real CI run is linked
A clean checkout reproduces both apps and tests; branch rules and deployment permissions preserve human launch authorization

workItems.title: Finish all contracted operator screens and accessibility states
workItems.observed: A shared records UI is useful, but it does not prove each of the 86 required screens and named workflows is complete or usable for its intended role.
implementation: Build task-specific typed editors and detail views from shared authoritative services
Finish loading/empty/error/denied/stale/conflict states, server pagination and saved views
Review keyboard, focus, labels, touch sizing and mobile read/edit paths for each screen
completionChecks: Every screen inventory entry has a concrete component/route and browser assertion
Owner, sales, integration admin, operations, finance, marketing and customer journeys are independently usable without JSON editing

workItems.title: Execute all cross-module, inherited and scale acceptance
workItems.observed: 139 tests and nine earlier browser journeys are useful evidence, but do not establish all A01-A40, T01-T30 or inherited E01-E25 assertions.
implementation: Create deterministic full-context acceptance fixtures and a per-assertion evidence runner
Run migration/security/domain/browser/recovery suites and measured load
Preserve PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED_EXTERNAL/COMING_SOON separately with exact commits and commands
completionChecks: All 95 scenario rows have their full assertions and observed results, not just a matching test filename
Measure 100k-variant search, 100 bulk updates and 500 queued renders; an unmet budget produces a failure and remediation

workItems.title: Consolidate owner acceptance and explicit activation
workItems.observed: Full active V1 acceptance remains open. Working previews do not authorize live suppliers, money, communications, domains or future modules.
implementation: Demonstrate apparel, commercial print and mixed-event-kit journeys with measured operator effort
Publish separate implementation, simulation, verified integration, failure and activation reports
Produce a reviewed staging/launch/rollback change set and keep all future features disabled
completionChecks: A consolidated owner review sees complete durable workflows and remaining external blockers
Production readiness requires the exact approved deployment and legal/financial/licensing evidence; no production mutation is implied
